protocol.selection_rule: Sequential first 10 held-out test cascades with complete timestamps (indices 0..9)
protocol.baseline_intervention: Zero-masking active node features with fixed graph topology
protocol.sign_convention: delta_p = baseline_probability - perturbed_probability. Positive values (>0) indicate confidence drop after masking (positive support).

methodological_guardrails.causality_disclaimer: Attribution scores quantify model prediction sensitivity under feature occlusion. They do NOT establish real-world causal responsibility or patient-zero identity.
methodological_guardrails.untrained_head_disclaimer: The STGNN auxiliary source_head was never trained and was not used in any calculation.
methodological_guardrails.sample_limitation: Evaluated on a deterministic 10-cascade sample from the held-out test split. Serves as an exploratory empirical investigation rather than a definitive whole-benchmark claim.
